notes.title: Wild West Blast – 1 Year & 70% Off! Remaster announced
notes.content:
[b] 1 Year of Wild West Blast* – Anniversary Sale **-70% OFF** & Major Announcement![/b]

One year ago – on May 1st, 2024 – we released [b]Wild West Blast[/b].
What started as a compact side project turned into our first commercial release – and the beginning of a much bigger journey.

To celebrate, [b]Wild West Blast[/b] is now **70% off** on Steam for a limited time!



[b] One year later – with way more experience under our belt[/b]
Since the release of [b]Wild West Blast[/b], we’ve worked on much more ambitious projects with complex systems, refined pipelines, and a significantly higher standard of quality, performance, and game feel.

Looking back at our first title, it’s clear:
[u][b]We can do much better now.[/b][/u]



[b]Wild West Blast – Remastered[/b]

[u][b]A full, free remake – coming late 2025[/b][/u]

Instead of patching the old build, we’ve decided to bring [b]Wild West Blast[/b] up to our current standards.
Faster, smoother, more intense – while staying true to its arcade roots.

Here’s what to expect:

* Technically refined core (performance, loading times, UI)
* Sharper hit feedback & improved gunplay
* More rewarding progression system
* Visual polish & new level elements
* And a ton of smaller improvements we now see as essential

[b]And the best part:[/b]
If you already own *Wild West Blast*, the Redux version will be [b]completely free[/b].



[b]Why a Remaster?[/b]

Because we’ve grown.
Because every project teaches us something.
And because [b]Wild West Blast[/b] deserves to shine in its best possible form.



So sure, grab it now on sale –
But the real blast is yet to come.

notes.title: Final Release, V1.1
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.1 – The Final Touch[/b]

Dear Community,

We’re thrilled to finally bring you the long-awaited Update 1.1! We know it took longer than originally promised, but we wanted to ensure all existing issues were thoroughly resolved. Now, we are proud to announce that the development of the game is officially complete. From this point on, only hotfixes and minor updates will be released if any further bugs are encountered.

Here’s an overview of the key changes and improvements:

- [b]Mission Bugfix:[/b] Fixed an issue where missions were always displayed on screen, even when you were not on a Map with includes missions.
- [b]Score Display:[/b] Fixed a bug where the score stayed on the screen for certain NPCs/items until a new score appeared.
- [b]Time Dilation:[/b] The Time Dilation effect is now properly used in Emerald River Valley.
- [b]Mouse Sensitivity:[/b] Fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity settings in the in-game menu were not applied directly and required a map restart.
- [b]Pause Menu:[/b] Fixed a bug where the game would continue running with the Pause Menu in the foreground after closing the settings menu with the ESC button.
- [b]Removed Sky Object:[/b] A leftover structure in the sky of Emerald River Valley from the development stage has been removed.
- [b]Syncing Issue:[/b] Fixed an issue with syncing.
- [b]Achievement System Overhaul:[/b] The achievement system has been reworked.
- [b]Highscore Expansion:[/b] Added new highscores to track lifetime animal kills and schnapps bottles destroyed.
- [b]Shop Improvement:[/b] You now start in the Guns tab when visiting the shop, instead of an empty window.
- [b]New Revolver:[/b] Added the revolver, along with two new achievements.
- [b]Savegame Structure Overhaul:[/b] The old savegame structures, which caused numerous shop bugs, have been completely overhauled. Unfortunately, this means that some of your progress will be partially reset.
- [b]New Map & Enemy:[/b] Added a new map featuring a new enemy type that offers higher cash rewards due to the increased risk of dying.
- [b]Additional Bugfixes:[/b] Various other issues have been resolved, including problems with the main menu music, slow text build-up in the map selection menu, and more.
- [b]Graphics Update:[/b] The Intel XeSS settings have been properly implemented after the UE5.3-UE5.4 port, and schnapps bottles are now more visible due to reduced opacity.

[b]Important Note:[/b] Due to the overhaul of savegame structures, your progress will be partially reset. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding and support throughout the development process.

We would like to sincerely thank all of you for your patience and feedback. Your input has been crucial in bringing the game to its best possible state. Although the development is complete, we will remain active to address any potential bugs and ensure you have the best possible gaming experience.

Thank you, and enjoy the game!

Best regards,  
Beaver Fever Games

notes.title: Patch 1.03 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Wild West Blast Players,

We are excited to announce the release of Patch 1.03, bringing new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.

[u][b]What's New in Patch 1.03:[/b][/u]

- [b]Scope Upgrade:[/b] Enhance your Lever Action Rifle with the newly added scope upgrade.
- [b]Sound Enhancements:[/b] New sounds for purchasing guns, upgrades, and maps, as well as repairing guns, have been added.
- [b]Emerald River Valley:[/b] Explore the new map featuring a unique gameplay element and bears.
- [b]Steam Achievement:[/b] Unlock an achievement for conquering the Emerald River Valley.
- [b]Online Highscores:[/b] Compete with others using the new online high scores feature through the Steam Community Hub.
- [b]Performance Improvements:[/b] A cap on spawned creatures has been implemented for better performance.
- [b]Animation Update:[/b] The fox running animation has been slightly modified.
- [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the local high score would occasionally reset.

We hope you enjoy these updates and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

The Wild West Blast Team

notes.title: V1.02 is now live!
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes 1.02[/b][/u]

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]

- [b]Ported:[/b] Upgraded from UE5 5.3.2 to 5.4.1.
- [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Fixed an issue where the main menu music stopped playing after one track finished.
- Fixed an issue where the durability of the Lever Action Rifle decreased with every click instead of every shot.
- [b]Increased Durability:[/b] The durability of all guns has been increased.
- [b]Removed Reload Costs:[/b] Reloading no longer incurs any costs.
- [b]Reduced Costs:[/b] The second map now costs less cash to purchase and travel to.
- [b]In-Game Menu:[/b] Added functionality to close the in-game menu with the ESC key.
- [b]Recoil Added:[/b] Added a slight recoil to all guns.
- [b]Upgrades Added:[/b] Upgrades for increased durability of the pistol and Lever Action Rifle have been added.
- [b]UI Overhaul:[/b] The user interface has been overhauled.

[u][b]Important Notice[/b][/u]

Due to changes in the way progress is now saved and loaded, there may be partial losses of previously unlocked content. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and are working to prevent such issues in the future.

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Releases for Wild West Blast
notes.content:
[u][b]Announcement[/b][/u]

Dear Wild West Blast Players,

We appreciate your patience and enthusiasm as we work on improving your gaming experience. Due to time constraints, we have decided to break down the originally planned 1.1 update into three smaller patches: 1.02, 1.03, and finally, Patch 1.1. This approach allows us to deliver essential fixes and improvements more quickly and efficiently.

We are excited to announce that Patch 1.02 is scheduled to be released on June 14. Patch 1.03 will follow later in June, and the final Patch 1.1 is expected to launch in early July.

Below, you'll find the detailed patch log for Patch 1.02.

[u][b]Patchlog 1.02:[/b][/u]

- Engine Update: Ported from UE5 5.3.2 to 5.4.1
- Bug Fixes:
  - Fixed a bug where the main menu music stopped playing after one track was over.
  - Fixed a bug where the durability of the Lever Action Rifle decreased after every click instead of each shot.
- [u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u]
  - Increased durability for all guns.
  - Removed reload costs.
  - Reduced cash cost to buy and travel to the second map.
  - Added a bit of recoil to all guns.
- [u][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b][/u]
  - Added the functionality to close the in-game menu with (ESC).
  - UI Overhaul.
- [u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]
  - Added upgrades for the Pistol and Lever Action Rifle to increase durability.

We hope these updates enhance your gameplay and make your Wild West adventures even more enjoyable. Stay tuned for the upcoming Patch 1.03 later in June and the final Patch 1.1 expected in early July, which will bring even more exciting features and improvements.

[u][b]Teaser:[/b][/u]
In the upcoming patches, look forward to a scope update for the rifle, a new map, and the introduction of a third weapon – the revolver!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

Happy gaming!

The Wild West Blast Team

notes.title: Wild West Blast 1.1 Release!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the next update for our game - Patch 1.1 - will be released in the june of 2024. This update will bring exciting new features and improvements that will further deepen and enrich the gaming experience.

What's new in Patch 1.1?

1. Complete Redesign of the User Interface (UI): Based on your valuable feedback, we will overhaul the entire UI. The new design improves navigation and aesthetics, allowing you to access important information faster and navigate through menus more easily.

2. New Upgrade for the Lever Action Rifle: The Lever Action Rifle just got even better! A state-of-the-art scope will be available for unlocking to enhance your accuracy. With this upgrade, you can precisely target score-boosting objects and animals from greater distances, giving you a clear advantage in any situation.

3. New Map: Explore our latest map, which presents fresh tactical challenges. This environment is specifically designed to fully utilize the newest upgrade for the Lever Action Rifle and offers more variety.

4. Based on feedback, the entire concept of in-game costs is being revised to make it easier for players to replenish their accounts in the future.

We are confident that these updates will make your gaming experience even better. The exact release date for Patch 1.1 will be announced later. We are working hard to get everything ready on time and look forward to sharing more details with you soon.

Stay tuned for more information and prepare to experience all the new features for yourself. Thank you for your ongoing support and commitment, which makes 'Wild West Blast' a fantastic gaming experience!

notes.title: Wild West Blast Patch 1.01
notes.content:
# Patch Notes Version 1.01

Welcome to the latest update for Wild West Blast! We're constantly working to enhance your experience and address issues based on your valuable feedback. Here's what's new and improved in this patch:

### Bug Fixes
- **Persistent Notification Bug**: Resolved an issue where messages such as "You're not allowed to use this gun" or "You already chose a gun" remained visible after multiple attempts to pick up the rifle in a short period. These notifications will now correctly disappear after each attempt.

### New Features
- **New Achievement**: We've added a brand new achievement to challenge and reward your skills. Dive in and see if you can unlock it!

### User Interface Enhancements
- **Score Display Adjustment**: To reduce confusion, the "Best Score" text will now only appear when a map has been selected.
- **Gun Visibility Improvements**: Enhanced the visibility of broken guns with a new text widget and a distinct clicking sound to indicate unusability.
- **Gunskins Menu Update**: Improved the visibility and accessibility of the menu for buying and selecting gunskins, making it easier to customize your gameplay experience.

### General Improvements
-The Game is now alot smaller in download and disk size due to optimizations.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new updates and keep aiming for the high score!
